headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
source: Telangana Today / The Hindu / Al Jazeera / Deccan Chronicle
bullets_en: Centre brings fresh Bill to raise Lok Sabha, Assembly seats by 50%.
KPSC released a list of 4,697 candidates.
Kyiv offers Black Sea ceasefire to protect grain exports.
Telangana Won’t Copy Sabarmati or Gujarat Model.
25 workers, including nine children, rescued from bonded labour in Hanumakonda.
bullets_ur: Markaz ne Lok Sabha aur Assembly ki nashestean 50 feesad barhanay ke liye naya Bill paish kar diya.
KPSC ne 4,697 ummeedwaron ki fehrist jari kar di.
Kyiv ne anaj ki baramadat ke tahaffuz ke liye Black Sea ceasefire ki paishkesh kar di.
Telangana Sabarmati ya Gujarat Model ki naqal nahi karega.
